# \<animateTransform\>

Baseline

Widely available

The **`<animateTransform>`** [SVG](/en-US/docs/Web/SVG) element animates a transformation attribute on its target element, thereby allowing animations to control translation, scaling, rotation, and/or skewing.

## In this article

## [Usage context](#usage_context)

| Categories | Animation element |
| --- | --- |
| Permitted content | Any number of the following elements, in any order: [Descriptive elements](/en-US/docs/Web/SVG/Reference/Element#descriptive_elements) |

## [Attributes](#attributes)

- [`by`](/en-US/docs/Web/SVG/Reference/Attribute/by)

- [`from`](/en-US/docs/Web/SVG/Reference/Attribute/from)

- [`to`](/en-US/docs/Web/SVG/Reference/Attribute/to)

- [`type`](/en-US/docs/Web/SVG/Reference/Attribute/type)

## [DOM Interface](#dom_interface)

This element implements the [`SVGAnimateTransformElement`](/en-US/docs/Web/API/SVGAnimateTransformElement) interface.

## [Example](#example)

html

```
<svg
  width="120"
  height="120"
  viewBox="0 0 120 120"
  xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <polygon points="60,30 90,90 30,90">
    <animateTransform
      attributeName="transform"
      attributeType="XML"
      type="rotate"
      from="0 60 70"
      to="360 60 70"
      dur="10s"
      repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </polygon>
</svg>
```

# SVG animation with SMIL

[Synchronized Multimedia Integration Language](https://www.w3.org/TR/SMIL/ "External link (opens in new tab)") (SMIL) is an XML-based language for writing interactive multimedia presentations. Authors can use SMIL syntax in other XML-based languages to define the timing and layout of elements for animation.

SMIL allows you to:

- animate the numeric attributes of an element ([x](/en-US/docs/Web/SVG/Reference/Attribute/x), [y](/en-US/docs/Web/SVG/Reference/Attribute/y), etc.)

- animate [transform](/en-US/docs/Web/SVG/Reference/Attribute/transform) attributes ([translation](/en-US/docs/Web/SVG/Reference/Attribute/transform#translate), [rotate](/en-US/docs/Web/SVG/Reference/Attribute/transform#rotate), etc.)

- animate [color](/en-US/docs/Web/SVG/Reference/Attribute/color) attributes

- follow a motion [path](/en-US/docs/Web/SVG/Reference/Element/path)

The following sections show how to use SMIL in [SVG](/en-US/docs/Web/SVG) for these four use cases.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a standalone animated SVG horse race illustration."""
import os

W, H = 1200, 800
OUT = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "output.svg")

out = []


def A(s):
    out.append(s)


A('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>')
A(f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 {W} {H}" width="{W}" height="{H}">')
A('  <title>Thunderous Finale - Animated Horse Race</title>')

# ---------------- defs ----------------
A('  <defs>')
A('    <linearGradient id="skyGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">')
A('      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#7EC7FF"/>')
A('      <stop offset="0.45" stop-color="#B3D8FF"/>')
A('      <stop offset="0.85" stop-color="#D6E7F5"/>')
A('      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#CFE2F2"/>')
A('    </linearGradient>')
A('    <radialGradient id="sunGlow" cx="0.5" cy="0.5" r="0.5">')
A('      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#FFF9E6"/>')
A('      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#FFCD63"/>')
A('      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#FFAB4D" stop-opacity="0.3"/>')
A('    </radialGradient>')
A('    <radialGradient id="sunFace" cx="0.4" cy="0.45" r="0.5">')
A('      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#FFF9E6"/>')
A('      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#FFD25C"/>')
A('      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#FFB24D"/>')
A('    </radialGradient>')
A('    <linearGradient id="hill1Grad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">')
A('      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#5A7A3F"/>')
A('      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#3F5D2C"/>')
A('      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#2F4B22"/>')
A('    </linearGradient>')
A('    <linearGradient id="groundGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">')
A('      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#3B6B30"/>')
A('      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#27422C"/>')
A('    </linearGradient>')
A('    <linearGradient id="trackGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">')
A('      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#3E5F2C"/>')
A('      <stop offset="0.4" stop-color="#4D6F39"/>')
A('      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#6C8F52"/>')
A('    </linearGradient>')
A('    <linearGradient id="grassEdge" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">')
A('      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#2F4B22"/>')
A('      <stop offset="0.3" stop-color="#4A6A33"/>')
A('      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#3B6B30"/>')
A('    </linearGradient>')
A('    <linearGradient id="standGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">')
A('      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#F7F4EA"/>')
A('      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#E6E1D6"/>')
A('    </linearGradient>')
A('  </defs>')

# ---------------- sky ----------------
A('  <g id="sky">')
A('    <rect x="0" y="0" width="1200" height="800" fill="url(#skyGrad)"/>')
A('    <g id="stars">')
for i in range(12):
    A(f'      <circle cx="{150 + i * 97}px" cy="{-10 + i * 40}px" r="1.4" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="{0.4 + (i % 3) * 0.2}">')
    A('        <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.8;0.3;0.8" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>')
    A('      </circle>')
A('    </g>')
A('    <g id="sun">')
A('      <circle cx="1050" cy="205" r="85" fill="url(#sunGlow)"/>')
A('      <circle cx="1050" cy="205" r="50" fill="url(#sunFace)">')
A('        <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.92;0.55;0.92" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>')
A('      </circle>')
A('      <circle cx="1050" cy="205" r="50" fill="#FFF8E4" opacity="0.65"/>')
A('      <path d="M1050 150 L1050 125 M1045 164 L1056 168 M1045 181 L1052 189 L1045 185" stroke="#FFD25C" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>')
A('      <path d="M1064 196 L1075 196 M1071 187 L1081 190 M1081 196 L1083 206" stroke="#FFB24D" stroke-width="3"/>')
A('      <circle cx="1040" cy="225" r="3" fill="#FFF8E4" opacity="0.5"/>')
A('    </g>')
A('    <g id="clouds">')
clouds = [
    (120, 92, 88, 52, 16, 18),
    (420, 105, 118, 58, 20, 24),
    (760, 88, 95, 48, 14, 16),
    (300, 145, 125, 62, 12, 20),
    (950, 128, 92, 50, 18, 22),
    (660, 155, 100, 45, 10, 14),
]
for i, (cx, cy, rx, ry, start, dur) in enumerate(clouds):
    A(f'      <g id="cloud{i}">')
    A(f'        <ellipse cx="{cx}" cy="{cy}" rx="{rx}" ry="{ry}" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#F0F5FB" stroke-width="3"/>')
    A(f'        <ellipse cx="{int(cx - rx * 0.45)}" cy="{int(cy - 3)}" rx="{int(rx * 0.4)}" ry="{int(ry * 0.65)}" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#F0F5FB" stroke-width="3"/>')
    A(f'        <ellipse cx="{int(cx + rx * 0.3)}" cy="{int(cy + 2)}" rx="{int(rx * 0.35)}" ry="{int(ry * 0.55)}" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#F0F5FB" stroke-width="3"/>')
    A(f'        <animateMotion path="M{start} {cy} L{start + 2400} {cy}" dur="{dur}s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>')
    A('      </g>')
A('    </g>')
A('  </g>')

# ---------------- hills ----------------
A('  <g id="hills">')
A('    <path id="hill1" d="M0 452 Q330 395 620 448 Q900 458 1200 450 L1200 690 L0 690 Z" fill="url(#hill1Grad)"/>')
A('    <path id="hill2" d="M0 505 Q450 440 750 450 L750 695 L0 695 Z" fill="#4D5F38"/>')
A('    <path id="hill3" d="M800 470 Q900 445 1000 465 Q1100 460 1150 445 L1150 695 L800 695 Z" fill="#3F5D2C"/>')
A('  </g>')

# ---------------- track ----------------
A('  <g id="trackAndRails">')
A('    <rect id="ground" x="0" y="660" width="1200" height="140" fill="url(#groundGrad)"/>')
A('    <rect id="track" x="140" y="460" width="720" height="200" fill="url(#trackGrad)"/>')
A('    <line id="trackLine" x1="140" y1="505" x2="860" y2="505" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="8" stroke-dasharray="26 18"/>')
A('    <line id="trackLine2" x1="140" y1="492" x2="860" y2="492" stroke="#F6F2E9" stroke-width="4"/>')
A('    <g id="rails">')
A('      <rect x="136" y="460" width="5" height="200" fill="#4A4138"/>')
A('      <rect x="855" y="460" width="5" height="200" fill="#4A4138"/>')
A('      <rect x="130" y="450" width="14" height="10" fill="#5B4B40"/>')
A('      <rect x="850" y="450" width="14" height="10" fill="#5B4B40"/>')
A('    </g>')
A('    <rect id="grassLeft" x="120" y="460" width="20" height="320" fill="url(#grassEdge)"/>')
A('    <rect id="grassRight" x="860" y="460" width="20" height="320" fill="url(#grassEdge)"/>')
A('    <g id="finishArea">')
A('      <rect x="830" y="460" width="12" height="200" fill="#F2E7B0"/>')
A('      <rect x="826" y="460" width="4" height="95" fill="#D43A2C"/>')
A('      <rect x="838" y="555" width="4" height="105" fill="#2B3D7E"/>')
A('      <rect x="844" y="460" width="8" height="24" fill="#2B3D7E"/>')
A('    </g>')
A('  </g>')

# ---------------- grandstand ----------------
A('  <g id="grandstand">')
A('    <polygon points="160,460 840,460 840,420 810,412 500,310 190,412 160,420" fill="url(#standGrad)" stroke="#3D3529" stroke-width="2"/>')
A('    <g id="seatRows">')
for y in (455, 445, 435):
    A(f'      <rect x="170" y="{y}" width="700" height="7" fill="#FFFDF3" stroke="#D5CEC1" stroke-width="1"/>')
A('    </g>')
A('    <g id="crowdOnStand">')
x = 215
while x < 838:
    A(f'      <circle cx="{x}" cy="368" r="3" fill="#1F1F1F"/>')
    A(f'      <circle cx="{x + 22}" cy="360" r="2" fill="#444444"/>')
    A(f'      <circle cx="{x + 44}" cy="368" r="3" fill="#1F1F1F"/>')
    x += 66
A('    </g>')
A('    <g id="flags">')
for i, c in enumerate(["#E63946", "#2B3D7E", "#F2E7B4", "#0D9488", "#D43A2C"]):
    fx = 320 + i * 100
    A(f'      <g transform="translate({fx}, 415)">')
    A(f'        <path d="M0 0 L18 -6 L18 16 Z" fill="{c}" stroke="#1C1C1C" stroke-width="1"/>')
    A('        <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="185" stroke="#4A4030" stroke-width="2"/>')
    A(f'        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0;5;-5;0" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="{i * 0.4}s"/>')
    A('      </g>')
A('    </g>')
A('  </g>')

# ---------------- crowd in front of stand ----------------
A('  <g id="crowdInFront">')
x = 175
while x < 845:
    cy = 512 + (x // 40) % 2
    A(f'    <circle cx="{x}" cy="{cy}" r="3" fill="#1F1F1F">')
    A(f'      <animate attributeName="cy" values="{cy};{cy - 4};{cy};{cy + 3};{cy}" dur="3.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>')
    A('    </circle>')
    x += 55
A('  </g>')

# ---------------- tote board ----------------
A('  <g id="toteBoard">')
A('    <rect x="615" y="378" width="170" height="74" rx="6" fill="#EFEFEF" stroke="#2E2E2E" stroke-width="2"/>')
A('    <text x="625" y="397" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2E2E2E">TOTE</text>')
for col, begin in [(625, 0.0), (700, 1.3)]:
    nums = ["3.40 / 2.85 / 7.10"] if col == 625 else ["5.20 / 1.90 / 4.05"]
    line_nums = nums[0].split(" / ")
    A(f'    <g id="toteCol{col}">')
    for k, num in enumerate(line_nums):
        y = 412 + k * 18
        A(f'      <text x="{col}" y="{y}" font-size="13" fill="#111111" text-anchor="middle">{num}</text>')
        A(f'      <animate attributeName="y" values="{y};{y - 5};{y};{y + 4};{y}" dur="2.6s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="{begin + k * 0.4}s"/>')
    A('    </g>')
A('  </g>')

# ---------------- photo-finish camera ----------------
A('  <g id="photoFinish">')
A('    <rect x="845" y="375" width="130" height="95" rx="4" fill="#2B2B36" stroke="#444444"/>')
A('    <rect x="858" y="388" width="104" height="50" fill="#0E0E12"/>')
A('    <rect x="858" y="388" width="104" height="50" fill="#F8E8A0">')
A('      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0.4;0;1;0.4;0" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>')
A('    </rect>')
A('    <text x="903" y="410" font-size="10" fill="#8A8A8A" text-anchor="middle">photo finish</text>')
A('  </g>')

# ---------------- horses ----------------
A('  <g id="horses">')
horses = [
    # name, dur, begin, body, mane, tail, silks, stripe, vest, number
    ("h1", 3.4, 0.0,  "#C1534A", "#7C3028", "#A04238", "#E63946", "#F1FAEE", "#2B3D7E", "5"),
    ("h2", 2.9, 0.5,  "#5E8B63", "#2F5D32", "#4A7A4A", "#F4A261", "#FFEDD0", "#C41E3A", "7"),
    ("h3", 3.8, 0.2,  "#5D7BC9", "#9FB5E8", "#93AEE2", "#F2E7B4", "#2E5C9B", "#D43A2C", "2"),
    ("h4", 2.7, 0.3,  "#E5A14D", "#A1692F", "#E5A14D", "#A8DADC", "#2B3D7E", "#F2E7B4", "9"),
]
HPATH = "M170 390 L830 390 L80 390"
LEGS = [
    ("fl", 10, 78, "26;-26;26", 0.0),
    ("fr", 26, 80, "-26;26;-26", 0.14),
    ("rl", 4, 76, "22;-22;22", 0.07),
    ("rr", 22, 78, "-22;22;-22", 0.11),
]
for hname, dur, begin, body, mane, tail, silks, stripe, vest, number in horses:
    A(f'    <g id="{hname}">')
    A(f'      <animateMotion path="{HPATH}" dur="{dur}s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="{begin}s"/>')
    A('      <g class="body">')
    A(f'        <rect x="0" y="0" width="88" height="96" rx="12" fill="{body}" stroke="#1C1C1C" stroke-width="2"/>')
    A(f'        <path d="M-13 4 Q-10 -8 0 -4 L14 -2 Q22 -4 26 4 L42 2 Q50 0 56 6 L64 26 L38 50 Q14 34 0 20 Z" fill="{mane}"/>')
    A(f'        <ellipse cx="-13" cy="10" rx="15" ry="16" fill="{body}" stroke="#1C1C1C" stroke-width="2"/>')
    A('        <path d="M-10 9 L-6 1 L-2 8 L-8 14" fill="none" stroke="#1C1C1C" stroke-width="2"/>')  # ear
    A(f'        <path d="M36 6 L42 12" stroke="{body}" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>')     # neck
    A(f'        <rect x="22" y="8" width="62" height="30" rx="4" fill="{silks}" stroke="#1C1C1C" stroke-width="2"/>')
    A(f'        <rect x="28" y="13" width="50" height="4" fill="{stripe}"/>')
    A(f'        <circle cx="44" cy="-19" r="7" fill="{silks}"/>')
    A('        <circle cx="44" cy="-19" r="4" fill="#FFFBEE"/>')
    A(f'        <rect x="6" y="34" width="12" height="14" rx="3" fill="{vest}"/>')
    A(f'        <text x="48" y="28" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle" fill="#111111">{number}</text>')
    A(f'        <path d="M88 40 Q100 46 102 62 Q100 78 88 90 Q80 98 62 100 L42 88 L62 60 Q72 44 88 38 Z" fill="{tail}"/>')
    # legs
    A('        <g id="legs">')
    for leg_id, hx, hy, vals, b in LEGS:
        A(f'          <g id="{hname}_{leg_id}">')
        A(f'            <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="{vals}" dur="0.42s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="{b}s"/>')
        A(f'            <g transform="translate({hx},{hy})">')
        A(f'              <path d="M0 0 L0 36" stroke="{body}" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>')
        A(f'              <path d="M0 36 L0 76" stroke="{body}" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>')
        A('              <circle cx="0" cy="76" r="5" fill="#1A1A1A" opacity="0.9"/>')
        A('              <rect x="-5" y="76" width="10" height="7" rx="2" fill="#222222"/>')
        A('            </g>')
        A('          </g>')
    A('        </g>')
    # dust puffs near front hooves
    A('        <g id="dust">')
    for dxy in [(30, 125), (52, 124)]:
        A(f'          <ellipse cx="{dxy[0]}" cy="{dxy[1]}" rx="7" ry="3" fill="#6B5C44" opacity="0.55">')
        A('            <animateMotion path="M0,0 L0,-14" dur="0.75s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>')
        A('          </ellipse>')
    A('        </g>')
    A('      </g>')
    A('    </g>')
A('  </g>')

A('</svg>')

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUT) or ".", exist_ok=True)
with open(OUT, "w") as f:
    f.write("\n".join(out) + "\n")
print("wrote", OUT, len(out), "lines")
